package_scope: Inference-only reproduction of the patent principal results; training code intentionally excluded.
source_selection: Inference mathematics and deterministic evaluation synthesis extracted from the newest verified compatible Moving-MNIST working tree updated in July 2026; older workspace checkout excluded.
architecture_constraint: Only the four-layer profile_plif path instantiated by all four supplied checkpoints is packaged. Strict state-dict loading is the version gate.
intentional_simplifications: Removed training entry points, optimizers, SupCon loss, training sampler, training YAML files and cache-preparation tools.
Removed dendritic, tri-compartment, task-conditioned and other architectures absent from all four checkpoint model states.
Retained the checkpoint fc layer solely so the saved model state loads strictly; predictions use the saved 128-to-10 probe.
Read inference and evaluation settings from each checkpoint embedded cfg instead of duplicating training configuration files.
Reduced Moving-MNIST to deterministic evaluation and paired-replay generation; online training augmentation is absent.

equivalence_checks.model: Original and compact implementations produced exactly equal 128-D representations and mean spike rates for the same seeded 16-frame input.
equivalence_checks.stimulus_function: Original and compact generators produced bit-identical videos for speed/flicker/noise/sparse-mask combinations.
equivalence_checks.evaluation_splits: The first five samples of each of the five splits were bit-identical in videos and labels against the verified source generator.
equivalence_checks.paired_replay: All 120 labels, indices, predictions and example videos matched exactly; two feature entries differed by one pooled boundary spike (max 1/256) and response mean max difference was 6.11e-6 on a repeated CUDA run.

checkpoint_scope: Four SupCon seed-0 best checkpoints selected by standard-test accuracy; inference uses model plus online probe.
excluded_historical_material: Split-wise peak values as principal-result evidence
